1 5:30 When can it be harder to use humour??At work. People tend to become more serious and transactional in professional settings, worrying that humour might make them seem less competent or undermine the gravity of the situation.
2 5:39 What trait inspires trust in a leader according to a recent survey??One of the top responses was "speaks like a regular person." People trust leaders who communicate in a natural, human way rather than hiding behind corporate language.
3 6:20 How can leaders use humour to appear more trustworthy??By making small shifts from transactional to human — for example, replacing a standard email sign-off with something unexpected that shows personality.
